$description: AUTHORED — presets, the 6th token source. A preset is a NAMED BUNDLE OF REFS into the other registries (fonts/moods/motion) — data composed FROM the generated styling, zero new code per preset. Cross-validated at build: an unknown ref fails the build. look = one-tap slide looks (W4 trays); motion = entrance choices. The editor's Save-as-preset appends here (data in the authored format, never generated output).
